source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 мая ст. ст. — «Мчч. Аверкия и Елены (I).»

attestations.note: The identification is the day and the company: the line pairs her with Abercius on the day this folder’s display name carries, and its Romanian and Greek rows keep the same pair on the same day. The calendar gives her, her brother and the apostle Alphaeus ONE page, life1141, and what it says of her is half a sentence: «Сестра его, святая Елена, была побита камнями» — his sister Helen was stoned to death. `dates` WAS WRITTEN WHERE THERE WAS NONE: the folder had no `dates` object, and the century is the one the line itself prints, «(I)». NO `ru` NAME FORM WAS STORED, DELIBERATELY: the calendar’s name link gives only «Елена, мц.», a bare forename, and «елена» is the fold key THIS BRANCH WROTE on 05-21 for `helen-martyr-1943` and `helen-the-empress` — a third holder would widen a key two batches old, and a fourth would have been added five batches later by `helen-korobova`, whose form was withheld for the same reason. The three Helens this branch met are reported together to the author, who can key the wider fold in one pass. `alphaeus-the-apostle` and `abercius-martyr-26-may` already stood as `related` rows and the Russian bears both out. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 26 mai — «Sfânta Muceniță Elena»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαΐου — «Αγία Ελένη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps «Sfânta Muceniță Elena» on, with the same bare name and the same rank. The Greek adds a brother and a manner of death, both on the synaxarists' word: «Στους Συναξαριστές αναφέρεται ότι ήταν αδελφή του Αγίου Αβερκίου (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα) και μαρτύρησε δια λιθοβολισμού» — sister of the Abercius kept on the same day, martyred by stoning. She is therefore, on the same page's reckoning, a daughter of the Apostle Alphaeus. She is none of the corpus's other women of this name — not `helen-the-empress`, not `helen-of-sinope`, not `helen-martyr-1943`, and not the `helen-of-decani` drafted from saint.gr's 21 Μαΐου. No year, no place, no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
